product_metadata.title: Gotham Steel Nonstick Griddle Pan – 10.5” Griddle Perfect for making Eggs, Pancakes, Bacon and More – Coated with Ceramic and Titanium, Dishwasher Safe with Stay Cool Stainless Steel Handles
features: Nonstick Griddle is perfect for making eggs, pancakes, bacon and much more
Award winning coating ensures the ultimate release -- everything just slides right off the pan, No need for oil or butter
Ultra-durable coating, scratch-proof & metal utensil safe
Aluminum composition ensure even heating distribution all around
Lightweight design makes for a comfortable cooking experience
free – All Gotham Steel products are PTHE, PFOA and PFOS free
description: Meet the Gotham Steel Pan with our revolutionary Ti-Cerama coating that combines super strong titanium fused with super slick ceramic for the perfect balance of nonstick and durability. With nothing sticking to the pan and food sliding off like you're cooking on air, Gotham Steel will change the way you cook – and clean. We’ve tried everything from burnt cheese to melted candy with the same exhilarating result - nonstick and easy clean up.
